texts.li: A party of {FACTION} has stopped {PLACE} and is pitching tents. They say they mean no harm and won't stay long.
Travelers of {FACTION} have made camp {PLACE}, and are unloading their packs as if they mean to stay a while.

li.label: Let them stay
li.outcome: Word goes out that they can stay. The camp {PLACE} will be there a while.

outcomes.li: [trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} walks out with a pot of something hot and tells them they're welcome. They will camp {PLACE} for a while.
[winter] The colony lets them be, and in this cold they look glad of it. They'll be camped {PLACE} a while yet.

li.label: Let them stay, on terms
li.outcome: They may stay, on terms the colony will set.

outcomes.li: [skill:Social] {A_nameDef} will go out and talk terms with them. They seem ready to listen.

li.label: Ask them to move on, with {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: They take the silver with thanks and go.

outcomes.li: They count the silver, thank {A_nameDef} twice, and start packing.

li.label: Ask them to move on
li.outcome: They take it badly, but they go.

outcomes.li: They grumble about the colony's manners all through the packing, but they go.

li.label: Drive them off
li.outcome: The strangers are told to be off the colony's land, now, and what will happen if they aren't. They pack in a hurry.

outcomes.li: The strangers don't wait to argue. They're gone within the hour, and their fire is still burning.
